subject: Post-demo: Buying Committee Recap & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joanna Price <jprice@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying Committee Recap & Next Steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — I really appreciate the thoughtful questions from the buying committee. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Highlights from the demo
- Real-time inference latency and throughput we demonstrated (1.2s P95 on a 4k seq for the 8B quant model).
- Example cost profiles for a lightweight reranking pipeline vs. full chat workloads (see slide 6).
- Security controls: VPC/private deployment option, KMS integration, audit logs and role-based access.

Stakeholder mapping (what I heard today)
- Economic buyer: Joanna Price (final sign-off on budget)
- Technical champion: Tom Alvarez (APIs, integration, POC lead)
- Security/legal: Priya Singh flagged the vendor security questionnaire and procurement redlines
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com (timeline and PO)

Agreed next steps
1) I'll share the recording + slide deck (attached) and a draft 6-month pilot SOW for review.
2) Vivek will scope a short POC plan (2-week data-integration + performance baseline) — draft in 48h.
3) Priya/procurement: please share the preferred security questionnaire template and any procurement timelines.
4) Joanna: can you confirm the decision criteria and target timeline for budget approval?

Attachments: redwood-demo-slide-deck.pdf, demo-recording-20260720.mp4, draft-sow-acme-6mo.docx

Thank you again — happy to hop on a short call this week if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0186

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying Committee Recap & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — good session. A couple quick clarifications from my side: 
- POC: we want the POC to include our anonymized session logs and a basic end-to-end integration with our chat front-end. 2 weeks sounds right as an initial baseline.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com has asked for an estimated cost sheet for the pilot (not final pricing) so they can provision a PO.

I'll loop procurement and our infra SME on the tech details.

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few items from my side to help prioritize: 
- Decision criteria: 1) measurable latency improvement vs our current hosted endpoint, 2) predictable unit economics (cost per 1k tokens under the pilot), 3) security posture (SOC2 + KMS) and 4) integration effort for our frontend.
- Timeline: we're aiming to make a budget decision in the next 6 weeks; procurement will require an estimated cost and a standard SOW to start the PO process.
- Pricing ask: can you provide a pilot price for 6 months (pilot estimated at 500k tokens/month) and any discounting you'd apply for an initial commercial commitment?

Priya — can you please share the security questionnaire template and any legal must-haves?

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying Committee Recap & Next Steps

Thanks Joanna — this is super helpful and aligns with what we heard. Below are concrete answers and updated next steps: 

Pricing & pilot
- Pilot estimate (baseline): 500k tokens/month x 6 months. Estimated list price: $0.012/token for the hosted endpoint profile used in demo -> ~$36,000/month. For the pilot we can offer a 30% pilot discount (applied to the first 6 months) plus waived setup fees. See attached draft SOW for billing terms and deliverables.

POC scope & timeline
- Vivek and I will deliver a 2-week POC plan within 48 hours that covers data ingestion, a baseline run, and integration checklist.
- Target start for POC: as soon as procurement confirms PO (typical lead time 2-3 weeks).

Security/legal/procurement
- Neha (cc'ed) will own the security questionnaire and legal redlines. Neha: please advise on required documentation (SOC2, penetration test report, encryption details) and an estimate for our standard contract turnaround.

Next concrete items (owners + ETA)
- Marissa: Share updated slide deck, demo recording, and draft SOW (attached) — today.
- Vivek: POC plan & required config (48h).
- Neha: initial security doc checklist & draft redline turnaround estimate (48-72h).
- Joanna/Procurement: confirm target PO timeline and any internal steps we should account for.

Links & attachments
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/RINF-2026-ACME-47
- Draft SOW attached: draft-sow-acme-6mo.docx (placeholder for signature)
- DocuSign prep link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/placeholder-link

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute call with the security/infra team this week to walk through the controls.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0186

Thanks Marissa and team — happy to own the security/legal thread. Initial checklist below (I'll follow up with formal docs): 
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Penetration test summary (last 12 months)
- KMS details and encryption-at-rest/in-transit description
- Data retention and deletion policy for pilot data
- Any subprocessor list and DPA (if required)

ETA: I'll send the SOC2 + pen-test artifacts and a proposed redline within 48 hours. If Acme has a vendor questionnaire, please share it and we'll fill it out directly.

-Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
